prompt: I lost a final against Greg Rusedski on grass, who won his 4th career singles title on grass against a player that once defeated me in the opening round of the US Open. I achieved my highest ranking in singles on what date?
answer:
The player was **Javier Frana**.

- Frana lost to Greg Rusedski in the **1993 Newport final** on grass.
- Rusedski won his **fourth career singles title** at the **1997 Nottingham Open**, defeating **Karol Kucera**.
- Kucera had previously beaten Frana in the **first round of the 1997 US Open**.
- Frana reached his career-high singles ranking of **No. 30 on 8 May 1995**.
